zh.description:
让桌宠陪你听歌，而不是替你听。需要 Coopani 0.2.16 以上，Windows 10/11。

**她怎么陪你听。** 你在 QQ音乐按下播放，几秒后她自己发现换歌了，说一句像样的：歌名、歌手、一句实话——「前奏八秒才进鼓，等得值」。歌往下走，她按这首的长短分两三段接着聊，落到刚唱过的那一两句词上，不念歌词本。你回她一句她接，不回也不催。动作踩的是这首歌真实的鼓点：副歌的鼓真进来了她才动，不是写死的钟摆。

**为什么她不会认错歌。** 读的是 Windows 的系统媒体会话（SMTC），播放器自己上报的歌名、歌手、进度，精确原文——不截屏、不做文字识别、不读播放器的内部数据库。

**她真的听得到，也分得清自己听到什么。** 三档从不混用：能量层（BPM、响度、低音倾向，一直在）、深听层（调性、和弦、主旋律音名、声部、乐器，按需）、印象层（她训练里记得的这首歌）。问她「你听得清吗」，她先去听再答；深听没配好就直接说，不装。

**深听两档，自己挑。** 云端（默认）：填一个 OpenAI 兼容接口的密钥就能用，不占本机空间，十几秒切片传上去、分析完即删；本地：约 500MB 的分离模型，之后完全不出这台机器。两档给同一套字段，每听一次并进这首的档案，攒出「前面是钢琴、副歌才进鼓」这种走向。

**她不会做的事。** 不编歌词、不编旋律；十几秒切片不是整首总谱；乐器只说「倾向」，不说成鉴定；不替你决定听什么；不主动动你的播放器——只有你明说「暂停」「下一首」她才按。没打开的开关，她绝不装作打开了。

**她要用的动作。** music_now 现在放什么、music_history 逐日记录、music_taste 常听歌手与循环曲、music_lyric 唱到哪几句、music_listen 仔细听十几秒、music_pick 自己搜一首并说清理由、music_soul 她自己的口味档案、music_note 记一条笔记、music_tag 标听感路数、music_control 暂停与切歌；另有十二个身体动作是本扩展加的：蹦迪、律动、打拍子、闭眼听、怔住、退半步、跟着哼、跟拍挥、余韵、凑近听、坐着哼、捂耳朵听。

**装它还需要什么。** 要跟拍得允许她采系统输出的能量（设置里能关，只有 Windows 有这条路）；本地深听另需 Python 3.10+，一条安装脚本搞定。那十二个动作住在桌宠宿主包里、npm 带不过来，所以启动时会自动补齐——会改宿主包里两个文件，动手前先备份，补完要再重启一次 Core 才生效，这个开关可以关。记忆默认在本机，可指到同步盘。

**和「大肥鱼环游世界」联动。** 装了那个扩展的话，你正在放的歌会跟着她出门：出发时她会提一句车上在放什么，长途的中间也可能说一次。歌名里带地名的（《成都》《回到拉萨》）会进她的「想去」清单——下次挑目的地时那个地方权重大得多，等于你放什么歌，就可能把她推到哪儿去。没装那个扩展就什么都不影响。

**已知限制：** 一首歌最多三段；网易云不上报进度，只能读窗口标题；两个客户端都不接受从外部点播，替她按播放要靠桌宠的「电脑操作」开关；曲风靠她认和逐步学，证据不足就说「还没标」。

en.description:
A companion who listens with you, not instead of you. Needs Coopani 0.2.16+ on Windows 10/11.

**How she listens with you.** You press play in QQ Music; a few seconds later she notices the change and says something worth hearing: title, artist, one honest line - "eight seconds of intro before the drums, worth the wait". As the song runs she splits it into two or three passages and keeps talking, landing on the line just sung instead of reciting the lyrics. Answer her and she picks it up; stay quiet and she does not push. Her motion follows the song's actual drums - she moves when the chorus beat really comes in, not on a fixed pendulum.

**Why she never gets the song wrong.** She reads the Windows system media session (SMTC): the title, artist and position that the player itself reports. No screen capture, no OCR, no digging into a player's internal database.

**She really hears, and she knows what she hears.** Three layers, never mixed: energy (tempo, loudness, low-end bias - always on), deep listening (key, chords, melody notes, stems, instruments - on demand), and memory (what she knows about this song from training). Ask "can you hear it properly?" and she listens first, then answers; if deep listening is not set up she says so instead of pretending.

**Two ways to deep listen.** Cloud (default): bring a key for any OpenAI-compatible model, nothing to download, the 12-second slice is uploaded, analysed, then deleted. Local: about 500MB of separation models, and nothing ever leaves this machine. Both return the same fields, and every listen is merged into a per-track sheet, so "piano first, drums only at the chorus" becomes something she can actually say.

**What she will not do.** She will not invent lyrics or melodies. A 12-second slice is not a full score. Instruments are always a leaning, never a verdict. She will not decide what you should listen to, and she will not touch your player on her own - only when you plainly say "pause" or "next". She never pretends a switch is on when it is off.

**What she can do.** music_now (what is on), music_history (day by day log), music_taste (top artists, repeats), music_lyric (lines reached), music_listen (listen closely for a few seconds), music_pick (search and pick one, with a reason), music_soul (her own taste file), music_note (keep a note), music_tag (tag how this one feels), music_control (pause, resume, skip). Twelve body motions also come from this extension: bounce, groove, tap, enjoy, stunned, recoil, hum, cheer, sigh, peek, humsit, ear-cover.

**Before you install.** Beat-following needs permission to sample the energy of the system output (can be switched off; Windows only). Local deep listening also needs Python 3.10+ and one install script. Those twelve motions live in the desktop-pet host pack and cannot ship with npm, so they are filled in at startup - that edits two files in the host pack, backed up first, and needs one more Core restart to take effect; the switch can be turned off. Memory stays on this machine by default and can be pointed at a synced folder.

**Works with Big Fish World Tour.** If that extension is installed, whatever you are playing ends up on the road with her: she mentions it when she sets off, and maybe once on a long leg. Song titles with a place in them go onto her wish list - which weighs heavily the next time she picks a destination, so what you play can genuinely push her somewhere. Without it, nothing changes.

**Known limits:** at most three passages per track; NetEase does not report progress, so only the window title is available; neither player accepts outside play requests, so pressing play for you depends on the pet's computer-control switch; genres are recognised and learned, and she says "not tagged yet" when the evidence is thin; patched motions need one Core restart.

coopani-world-pz.description: 陪玩僵毁（需 Coopani 0.2.17+）:她读游戏自己写出来的状态,不是屏幕。天要黑了催你回屋、被围了让你跑、被咬一口先骂你再问伤口、找到大锤跟着高兴、死了会记住这局。只看不动手,也不剧透。

zh.description:
陪玩僵毁（需 Coopani 0.2.17 以上）：她读的是游戏自己写出来的状态，不是屏幕。

**她看得到什么。** 游戏内时刻与第几天、天黑了没有、在不在室内和哪个房间、生命值、感染状态、饥饿、口渴、疲劳、耐力、心情（疼痛、惊恐、压力、不高兴、无聊）、此刻视野里有多少僵尸、手上拿的什么以及耐久、背包里大致有什么（绷带、食物、水、光源）。还有即时事实：掉血、被咬、感染、击杀、死亡。

**她看不到什么。** 你的屏幕、你的准星、身上的地图、下一间屋子里有什么、你刚弄出的响动。mod 加的东西她也不认识，除非它体现成上面那些数字。

**什么时候开口。** 天要黑了还在外面、视野里的僵尸跨了一档、血量掉下来、被感染、连杀、死了。另外两类不一样：他自己的状态（饿了、渴了、累到底、体力空了、疼、慌、烦、闷）跨档时她会评价一句——那不是危险通知，是她真的在看你这个人；手上的武器耐久掉到 20% 以下、5% 以下各说一次，换武器不报、修好了再磨下去还能再说。他翻柜子翻到大锤、发电机、好武器或工具时她会提一句「别顺手划过去」——**只看他亲手打开的那一个容器**，不预告没去过的房间。前期电视上有技能课（Life and Living TV）时她也会提一句——那是白涨经验，一停电就没了。打开「让她自己动手玩」之后她还能真的操作角色：走过去、转身、打身边的僵尸、从打开的柜子里拿东西——寻路和命中判定交给游戏引擎，她只负责去哪、拿什么。每条都是事实通知，不是命令——怎么反应她自己定。

**四档口吻，你挑。** 毒舌队友、稳当搭档、慌里慌张的学妹，或者「按局面切换」——平时损你，真要命的时候收起来。换的是措辞和先想哪件事，换不掉「该提醒的必须提醒」。

**她不替你打。** 不模拟点击、不刷物品、不告诉你地图上有什么。鼠标在你手上。

**怎么装。** 第一次启动会把一个小 Lua 桥接 mod 放进 `Zomboid/mods/CoopaniBridge`，数据写到 `Zomboid/Lua/coopani-pz/`。在游戏的 mod 列表里启用一次，之后全自动；卸掉之后游戏和没装一样。

**已知限制。** 必须游戏在跑、并且读了档——主菜单什么都没有。这台机器上游戏一次都没启动过，所以第一次进游戏也是第一次真机验证；如果数据没到，她会说清缺哪一步，不会闷着。

en.description:
Plays Project Zomboid alongside you (needs Coopani 0.2.17+). She reads what the game itself writes out, not your screen.

**What she sees.** In-game clock and day count, whether it is dark, whether you are indoors and which room, health, infection, hunger, thirst, fatigue, stamina, the mood stats (pain, panic, stress, unhappiness, boredom), how many zombies are visible right now, what is in your hands and its condition, and roughly what your bag holds - bandages, food, water, a light source. She also gets facts as they happen: taking damage, getting bitten, getting infected, killing, dying.

**What she does not see.** Your screen, your aim, the map you are carrying, what is in the next house, or the noise you just made. She does not know what a mod added unless it shows up in the numbers above.

**When she speaks up.** Dusk coming and you are still outside; the visible-zombie count jumping a band; your health dropping; infected; a kill streak; death. Two things are different in kind: when one of your own condition stats crosses a band (hungry, thirsty, worn out, out of stamina, in pain, panicking, stressed, low, bored) she says something - that is not a hazard report, that is her actually watching the person and not just the scene; and when the weapon in hand drops under 20% and again under 5%, once per weapon per band - swapping weapons says nothing, and repairing then wearing it down again earns another word. She also speaks up when the container he has just opened holds a sledgehammer, a generator, a real weapon or a tool - only the one container he opened, never a room he has not searched. Early on she also flags the free skill programmes on Life and Living TV - they cost nothing and vanish once the power goes out. Each one is a fact, not an order - how she reacts is hers to decide.

**Four voices, your pick.** Straight-talking teammate, steady partner, jumpy underclassman, or a switch that goes quiet when things get serious. It changes how she says it and which thing she reaches for first - never whether she warns you.

**She does not play for you.** No simulated clicks, no item spawning, no map reveal. The mouse is yours.

**Setup.** The first time it runs it drops a small Lua bridge mod into `Zomboid/mods/CoopaniBridge` and writes its data to `Zomboid/Lua/coopani-pz/`. Enable it once in the in-game mod list; after that it is automatic. Uninstalling leaves the game exactly as it was.

**Known limits.** The game must be running with a save loaded - the main menu produces nothing. It has never been able to test against a save on this machine, so the first launch is also the first real test; if nothing arrives she will say what is missing instead of staying quiet.

zh.description:
「活人感」的加速搭档：让桌宠的心事和你的话一起发给模型，桌宠一轮就开口。必须先装「活人感」。

**两个扩展怎么配合**

- **活人感**（World，必装）：负责想心事、查 AI 固定句式。单独装就能用。
- **活人感 provider**（就是本扩展，可选）：一种新的模型端点「活人感」，包住 Coo 连接，把心事直接放进发给模型的请求里，省掉桌宠先调工具读心事的那一轮。
- 只装本扩展、不装「活人感」，没有任何作用。

**怎么用**

1. 在扩展页把「活人感」和本扩展都装上，重启 Coopanion。
2. 到 World 页打开「活人感」，在「配置 → 基本设置」里勾「切换到活人感端点」：会照着你现在的端点复制一个「活人感」端点（地址、模型、Key 都一样）并切过去。
3. 再重启一次 Coopanion，按提示把活人感关掉再打开一次。

**只影响你切过去的那个端点**，别的端点和 Coopanion 本身都不动。目前只支持 Coo 连接的端点。

**怎么看生没生效**：World 页「活人感」的「provider」徽章显示「已生效」。

**不想用了**：「基本设置」里关掉「用「活人感 provider」」（请求原样发出），或者勾「切回原来的端点」。

**卸载前一定先切回原来的端点**（勾「切回原来的端点」并重启），不然 Coopanion 找不到这种端点，桌宠会说不了话。

en.description:
A speed-up companion for Humanize: sends the pet's inner thought along with your words, so the pet answers in one round. Requires the Humanize World.

**How the two extensions fit together**

- **Humanize** (World, required): writes the inner thought and checks stock AI sentence patterns. Works on its own.
- **Humanize provider** (this one, optional): a new model endpoint type, "Humanize", that wraps the Coo connection and puts the thought straight into the request, saving the round where the pet first calls a tool to read it.
- This extension alone does nothing.

**Getting started**

1. Install both Humanize and this extension, then restart Coopanion.
2. On the World page, open Humanize → Config → Basic and tick "Switch to the Humanize endpoint": it copies your current endpoint (address, model, key) into a Humanize endpoint and switches to it.
3. Restart Coopanion again, then turn Humanize off and on once when prompted.

**Only the endpoint you switch to is affected**; other endpoints and Coopanion itself are left alone. Coo endpoints only for now.

**Uninstall**: switch back to your original endpoint first (tick "Switch back" and restart), or the pet cannot speak.

让 Coo 听见麦克风：你说的话在本机识别成文字，作为事件送给 Coo,由 Coo 自己决定怎么回。

**功能**
- 按音量门槛判断有没有人在说话，咳嗽、键盘声这类短促的声音会被挡掉
- 本机 FireRedASR2-AED 识别中英文，有 NVIDIA 显卡用显卡，没有就用 CPU
- 一口气说的几句并成一条送给 Coo,默认听见就叫醒
- 结果转简体，可配纠错表，模型在噪声上编出来的句子会被丢掉
- 自带字幕页，可作为 OBS 浏览器源叠在直播画面上

**安装后还需要**
1. 本机装好 git 与 uv 并放进 PATH;用显卡档要 NVIDIA 显卡和支持 CUDA 12.8 的驱动
2. 在「收听」面板点「安装运行时」(PyTorch 约 3 GB)和「下载权重」(约 4.7 GB)
3. 在「识别后端」那一栏点「启动」
4. 详细步骤见 [README](https://github.com/Phantivia/cortico-world-asr#安装前准备)

托管安装只支持 Windows 与 Linux,macOS 可以接自备的兼容转写端点。可缇 Corti 直播在用的语音识别。

en.description:
Lets Coo hear your microphone: what you say is transcribed on your machine and delivered to Coo as an event, and Coo decides how to reply.

**Features**
- A level threshold tells when someone is talking; short sounds such as coughs and keyboard clicks are filtered out
- Local FireRedASR2-AED recognizes Chinese and English, on an NVIDIA GPU if present, otherwise on the CPU
- Sentences said in one go reach Coo as one event; by default speech wakes Coo right away
- Output in Simplified Chinese, an optional correction list, and phrases the model invents on noise are dropped
- A built-in subtitle page that works as an OBS browser source

**After installing you also need**
1. git and uv installed and on PATH; the GPU profile needs an NVIDIA card with a driver that supports CUDA 12.8
2. In the 收听 (Listen) panel, click 「安装运行时」 (install runtime, PyTorch about 3 GB) and 「下载权重」 (download weights, about 4.7 GB)
3. Click 「启动」 (start) in the 「识别后端」 (backend) row
4. Full steps in the [README](https://github.com/Phantivia/cortico-world-asr#before-you-install)

Managed install supports Windows and Linux only; on macOS connect your own compatible transcription endpoint. The speech recognition used on Corti's live streams.

en.description:
Lets Coo browse bilibili, pick videos and watch them in a signed-in browser window. That window is the stream picture, so the audience sees what Coo sees.

**Features**
- Search videos, open video pages, list related videos, read comments, scroll and take snapshots
- Full-page playback, pause, seek, change quality, and a large image of the current frame
- While watching, a grid of recent frames every few seconds, with that stretch's subtitles and the video's own danmaku
- Coo is told when the operator changes video or pauses, when the video ends, and when playback stalls
- QR-code sign-in and browser open and close from the World tab

**Also needed after install**
1. Chrome or Edge on this computer; if it is installed elsewhere, set the browser program path in the settings
2. Sign in by scanning the QR code in the 「B 站授权」 panel of the World tab with the bilibili app; without it, login-only qualities and subtitles are unavailable
3. For streaming, capture this browser window in OBS
4. Full steps are in the [README](https://github.com/Phantivia/cortico-world-bilibili-video#before-you-install)

en.description:
Lets Coo play Buckshot Roulette (Steam): loads, shots, items, health and dialogue reach Coo as they happen, and Coo picks up the shotgun, uses items and works the menus itself.

**Features**
- Plays the story, Double or Nothing and multiplayer lobbies
- Shell counts, revealed shells, health and dialogue arrive as events, with a screenshot at key moments
- Coo operates table targets, menus and settings through tools, and can send keyboard, mouse and gamepad input
- Local join: the operator opens a second game window on the same PC and plays Coo at the same table
- The WebUI tab starts and closes the game and shows the current view

**After installing you also need**
1. Buckshot Roulette from Steam on Windows, version v2.2.0.6
2. Set 游戏程序 (game executable) in the World page settings to `Buckshot Roulette.exe`
3. The implant pack is generated automatically the first time the World starts the game; nothing to compile
4. Full steps in the [README](https://github.com/Phantivia/cortico-world-buckshot#before-you-install)

Windows only. A reference implementation verified on CortiV live streams; compatibility with other Personas and non-streaming use has not been tested.

en.description:
Lets Coo paint with p5.brush strokes on a local studio page and host a draw-and-guess game. Strokes play live on the page and the stream overlay, and screenshots come back to Coo in tool results.

**Features**
- Draws named path parts: solid or watercolor fills, pressure-sensitive line art, pencil, marker, charcoal, hatching
- Edit by step, move, scale or rotate parts, undo, save as PNG
- People upload reference images on the page; Coo views and copies them, with zoom
- Draw-and-guess: the page shows only the answer length and a hint, Coo is notified when time runs out, and the scoreboard carries across rounds
- An overlay view (/overlay) for OBS

**After installing you also need**
1. Google Chrome installed, or a Chromium-based browser path in the settings
2. A model that can see images (recommended), or Coo cannot see the drawing
3. See the [README](https://github.com/Phantivia/cortico-world-canvas#before-you-install) for details

- Coo 用分步计划控制车速和方向,每步开几秒、几米、转几度或停稳再走下一步
- 任务、画面提示、情境区、罚款、碰撞、地雷、违规倒计时、关卡结束实时推给 Coo,关键事件附截图

en.description:
Puts Coo in the driver seat of Teach my little sister how to drive: the person in the passenger seat gives directions, and Coo works the throttle, the steering and the seatbelt itself.

**Features**
- Coo drives with a step-by-step plan of speed and steering, each step held for some seconds, metres, degrees turned or until stopped
- Missions, on-screen hints, situation zones, fines, collisions, mines, violation countdowns and stage results reach Coo as they happen, key ones with a screenshot
- During a stage, the latest view and a top-down view come along periodically; Coo is woken once if it has not driven for a while
- Coo can take a screenshot to check the road, restart the stage, load the next one or go back to the menu
- The game's own sister model, game voice and microphone are switched off and Coo takes their place

**After installing you also need**
1. The game from Steam, copied outside the Steam library, with BepInEx 5
2. The plugin in `plugin/` built with the .NET 8 SDK and placed in the copy's `BepInEx/plugins/`
3. 游戏程序 (game executable) in the settings pointed at the copy's exe, with Steam running when it starts
4. Full steps in the [README](https://github.com/Phantivia/cortico-world-cortidrive#before-you-install)

Windows only. A reference implementation verified on CortiV live streams; compatibility with other Personas and non-streaming use has not been tested. The version where Coo coaches from the passenger seat is cortico-world-sisterdrive.

点词看释义与词根，点句让 Coo 翻译讲解，生词本按间隔复习。

## 学习版说明

- 评论态度锁定「严谨」，只做语言与剧情的中性说明；
- 「开发者模式」与其他模式置灰、不可点；
- 只保留查词、词根、整句讲解、生词复习与朗读。

## 具体功能

- 点词卡：音标、词性、中文释义、词根拆解、同根词。
- 问 Coo 这个词：本地词典与 Coo 的补充并存。
- 整句讲解：Alt+点击或选中一段英文。
- 生词本：加入、编辑、导入 JSON/CSV、按 1/2/4/7/15/30 天复习。
- 朗读：系统语音合成，可调语速。
- 非学习模式：关闭查词与复习，只保留陪玩评论。

## 使用方法

1. Coopanion 扩展页从本机目录安装本 World，重启并启用；
2. 游戏内安装 CooBridge.mod.zip 并重新载入；
3. 点单词或 Alt+点击句子；首次连接回答 Coo 的「学英语 / 只想玩」。

## 实验性说明

- 只验证 DoL 0.5.12.13 + ModLoader 2.101.1（Windows）；
- 高 token 消耗；
- 需额外安装游戏、ModLoader 与 DoL 模组。

en.description:

click words for gloss and roots, select sentences for Coo's translation and notes, review vocabulary with spaced repetition.

Learning edition: comments are locked to Strict and stay neutral; Developer mode and other modes are disabled.

## Features

- Word cards: phonetic, POS, gloss, roots, word family.
- Ask Coo: local dictionary plus Coo's extra context.
- Sentence explanation: Alt+click or select text.
- Vocabulary book: add, edit, import JSON/CSV, review every 1/2/4/7/15/30 days.
- Speech: system TTS with adjustable rate.
- Companion mode: turn off lookups and review.

## Usage

1. Install this World in Coopanion from a local folder, restart and enable.
2. Install CooBridge.mod.zip in the game and reload.
3. Click a word or Alt+click a sentence; answer Coo's first-run question.

## Experimental

- Verified with DoL 0.5.12.13 + ModLoader 2.101.1 (Windows) only.
- High token usage.
- Requires the game, ModLoader and the DoL mod.

zh.description:
和 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）对话，让它帮你干活、写代码；宠物回复你的时候用内置语音包读出声（Windows 与 macOS）。桥接需要先装 DSH 的 Host 插件才会连——不会装就看源码仓库说明，或把仓库地址交给 AI 帮你装。会话选择器与「解除固定」需 Host 插件 coopanion-connector-dsh ≥ 0.2.11，「新建会话」需 ≥ 0.2.12，上下文自动交接需 ≥ 0.2.18（仅 GitHub 分发，未上 npm）。

### 0.6.21 修复：手动切会话被抢回 + 新建/列会话超时说明

- **切会话不再被抢回**：之前小肥鱼钉着会话时，你在 DSH 里切到别的会话说话，它会立刻把桥接归属抢回旧会话；现在连续在线时以 DSH 的实际归属为准、自动跟随你切到的会话，断线重连时才恢复自己的固定
- **新建会话给明确结论**：Host 侧新建接口 8 秒不返回就带原因失败，不再让小肥鱼干等 20 秒后只报「超时」；Host 不支持列会话时也直接说明，而不是等到超时

### 0.6.20 新增：上下文将满自动交接 + 「只当嘴」模式

- **自动交接（需 connector-dsh ≥ 0.2.18）**：DSH 在 `turn-end` 上报上下文用量，到 90% 自动新建会话、钉住、切过去并投递交接种子；Host 不报用量时回退 400 轮兜底，每个会话最多交接一次
- **只当嘴模式**：另一个 world 注入 `globalThis.__cooPetSayRaw` 后，批准 / 回答 / 出错 / 回复直接进气泡、不叫醒桌面 AI；回合标记与工具调用保持静默

### 0.6.16 新增：朗读引擎可插拔 + 可选分句流水线

- **engine = edge（默认）**：内置微软 Edge TTS，行为与旧版一致
- **engine = http**：`POST {input, voice, speed}` 到 `httpUrl`，返回 wav/mp3，走原有播放/打断链路；服务挂掉时 `fallbackEdge` 静默回退 Edge，宠物不会失声
- **sentencePipelineEnabled（默认关）**：短气泡按句切开、播上一句时预合成下一句，减少句间空隙；超过 `sentencePipelineMaxChars`（默认 40）的长句仍整段合成

### DSH 通知四档，默认不再逐条唤醒

- **notify = results（默认）**：每轮结束合并成一条通知（含 DSH 的回复与本轮工具调用次数），批准 / 回答 / 出错立即推送——不再每次工具调用都叫醒桌宠，省 token
- **notify = decisions（0.6.18 新增）**：只在需要批准 / 回答或出错时唤醒，每轮结果与回复不推也不缓存，比 results 更省 token
- **notify = all**：保留旧行为，每个事件一条
- **notify = off**：只发送不接收，桌宠仍能向 DSH 说话，DSH 不再唤醒桌宠
- 不需要升级 connector，旧版 Host 同样生效

### 新装用户请注意：两个转发开关默认都关

- **relayPerson**（转发人物打字到 DSH）默认关 → 想让打字自动进 DSH，在配置里打开它。这是主路径功能，旧版本曾默认开，本次回归 opt-in
- **relayPet**（转发桌宠台词到 DSH）默认关 → 想让桌宠说的话也变成 DSH 的 user/message，打开它。但注意：如果同时开了 relayPerson + connector 侧 forwarding，容易形成"桌宠↔DSH"两嘴互聊循环，通常保持默认关更安全

### 会话选择器（0.6.11 起）

- 桥接面板多一颗「选择会话」：列出 DSH 全部实时会话，点一行就把桌宠切过去，不用猜 id
- 「解除固定」现在会真的通知 DSH 侧插件清掉固定（此前只清桌宠自己那份状态，DSH 仍把消息送进已放开的会话）
- 每次刷新状态都会向 DSH 问一次它当前落在哪个会话，切 tab 后面板不再停在旧会话
- 0.6.12 新增「新建会话」按钮与 Coo 的 dsh_new_session 工具：所有会话被归档后可在 DSH 侧开一个并自动接上（PR #5，致谢 @ink1453）

### 为什么建议 connector-dsh ≥ 0.2.12

- v0.2.12 新增 `new` / `created` 帧：没有它，「新建会话」与 dsh_new_session 会连上但一直等不到会话
- v0.2.11 新增 `list-sessions` 与 `unpin` 帧：没有它，会话列表会读超时、解除固定只清本地
- v0.2.10 修复 CSWSH 安全漏洞（任意网页可构造 WS 升级劫持桥接）并让自动转发持久化
- connector 是独立仓库：https://github.com/blacksunshy/coopanion-connector-dsh （仅 GitHub 分发，未上 npm）

en.description:
Chat with DeepSeek Harness (DSH) so it does the work and writes code for you, and hear the pet replies read aloud with built-in voices (Windows and macOS). The bridge needs the DSH Host extension installed first — if that sounds hard, open the source repo and let an AI walk you through it. The session picker and unpin need coopanion-connector-dsh >= 0.2.11, "New session" needs >= 0.2.12, auto-handover needs >= 0.2.18 (GitHub only, not on npm).

### Fixed in 0.6.21: manual session switches are no longer yanked back, and timeouts say why

- **No more yanking**: while the pet had a session pinned, speaking in another DSH session made it re-pick the old one. A live owner change now follows DSH, and the local pin is only restored after a reconnect
- **New session reaches a verdict**: the Host now fails creation with a reason after 8s instead of leaving the pet to report a bare timeout at 20s; a Host that cannot list sessions says so instead of timing out

### New in 0.6.20: auto context handover + mouth-only mode

- **Auto-handover (needs connector-dsh >= 0.2.18)**: the Host reports context usage at `turn-end`; at 90% a fresh session is created, pinned, picked and seeded; falls back to a 400-turn cap when usage is unavailable, at most once per session
- **Mouth-only mode**: when another world injects `globalThis.__cooPetSayRaw`, approvals / questions / errors / replies go straight to the bubble without waking the desktop AI; turn markers and tool calls stay silent

### New in 0.6.16: pluggable speech engine + optional sentence pipeline

- **engine = edge (default)**: built-in Microsoft Edge TTS, exactly the old behaviour
- **engine = http**: POST `{input, voice, speed}` to `httpUrl`, expect wav/mp3; playback and interruption stay the same, and `fallbackEdge` quietly falls back to Edge so the pet is never mute
- **sentencePipelineEnabled (default off)**: split short bubbles at sentence punctuation and pre-synthesise the next sentence while the current one plays; lines above `sentencePipelineMaxChars` (default 40) stay one clip

### Four DSH notice modes (0.6.18 adds decisions), no wake per event by default

- **notify = results (default)**: each finished turn becomes one notice (the reply plus how many tools it ran), while approvals, questions and errors are pushed right away — tool calls no longer wake the pet one by one, saving tokens
- **notify = decisions (new in 0.6.18)**: wake only for approvals, questions and errors; turn results and replies are neither pushed nor queued, the leanest option
- **notify = all**: the old behaviour, one notice per event
- **notify = off**: send only, never receive — the pet still talks to DSH, DSH never wakes it
- No connector upgrade needed; older Host versions work the same

### Fresh install note: both forward switches default OFF

- **relayPerson** (relays your typing into DSH) defaults off → open it if you want auto-flow from your keyboard. Main path, previously default-on in older releases.
- **relayPet** (relays pet lines into DSH) defaults off → open it if you want pet words as DSH user/messages. Warning: with relayPerson + connector forwarding on, pet↔DSH chat loops can form.

### Session picker (since 0.6.11)

- The bridge panel gained a "Pick session" button: it lists every live DSH session and one click moves the pet there, no id guessing
- "Unpin" now really tells the DSH side to drop the pin (before, it only cleared the pet's local state while DSH kept writing into the session you had released)
- Every status refresh asks DSH which session it is actually on, so the panel stops showing a stale session after you switch tabs
- 0.6.12 adds a "New session" button and Coo's dsh_new_session tool: when every conversation is archived, start one on the DSH side and attach to it (PR #5, thanks @ink1453)

### Why connector-dsh >= 0.2.12

- v0.2.12 adds the `new` / `created` frames: without them, "New session" and dsh_new_session connect but never get a conversation
- v0.2.11 adds the `list-sessions` and `unpin` frames: without them the list read times out and unpin only clears local state
- v0.2.10 fixes a CSWSH security hole (any webpage could forge a WS upgrade to hijack the bridge) and persists the forward switch
- Connector lives in its own repo: https://github.com/blacksunshy/coopanion-connector-dsh  (GitHub only, not on npm)

她自己的情绪，不是对你的好感度。

八条轴各走各的：喜悦、信任、不安、惊讶、难过、厌恶、愤怒、期待。有的几分钟就退，有的一压好几天。自己涨，也自己退，不用谁哄。

en.description:
Her own mood, not an affinity score for you.

Eight axes each drift on their own: joy, trust, fear, surprise, sadness, disgust, anger, anticipation. Some settle in minutes, some weigh on for days. They rise and fade by themselves, nobody has to talk her down.

She changes with them: shorter, softer, sharper, or quiet today. All of it is her own real reaction. No one gets scored, her memory and her promises are untouched. Comes with a live panel: the eight axes right now, the last 24 hours, and more.

zh.description:
陪打炉石（需 Coopani 0.2.17 以上）：她读的是游戏自己写的对局日志，不是屏幕。

**她看得到什么。** 双方职业与英雄、生命值与护甲、场上每个随从的攻击力与生命和关键词、两边手牌与牌库张数、水晶、回合数、谁打了什么牌。**开局换牌阶段还看得到起手那几张的牌名和费用。**

**她看不到什么。** 对手手牌具体是哪几张、卡牌的文字效果、动画和演出。日志比画面晚几百毫秒，极快的一瞬间可能漏掉。信息没跟上时她会直说没看到，不会用推测把场面补完整。

**该开口的时候开口。** 轮到你了她说这回合打什么；残血、被铺场、牌库见底、进入斩杀线时她会提醒；打出意料之外的牌（跨职业的、比水晶还贵的、8/8 以上的）她会愣一下。开局换牌只来一次，过时不补——那是唯一能改起手的机会。

**算得清的账。** 斩杀线把场面、武器、英雄攻击力、过墙和手牌里的直伤一起算进去，并说明哪些没算（光环、潜行、免疫、战吼伤害不在数里，所以那个数是下界）。对手有嘲讽时，过墙用掉多少攻击力会写清楚——9 攻打 2 血嘲讽，剩的是 0 不是 7。硬币算进预算了，被加价时会提醒你「打了也换不到水晶」。

**她拦得住几种常见的错。** 血厚没嘲讽不是墙；带前提的战吼没满足就只是个随从；狂怒、复生、亡语这些打下去还有后续；同一张牌连劝四个回合就不是牌友了，是催命的。

**她有自己的打法档案。** 信哪一套、话多话少、看到臭手会不会直接说——边打边写，越打越像她。但有一条她不能拿风格当理由：**算出的斩杀必须喊，建议里点出的风险必须转告。**

**按谁的思路打，你说了算。** 面板上一个按钮：默认按她自己的立场，也能切到「你的」——那份不是猜的，是从你的对局记录里数出来的：你多久听一次建议、哪个回合段开始自己拿主意、没听的时候先打了哪几张。每打完一局自动重算。切到「你的」之后她照样会反驳你，**算出来的斩杀和风险一样必须说** —— 立场换的是措辞和先推哪条，不是数字。

**打完能复盘。** 逐回合的双方血量、手牌数、场面，加上全部出牌与攻击。她说得出「第 13 回合你场攻 11，对面 14 血，那回合已经进斩杀窗口了」，而不是「你打得不错」。

**竞技场也认。** 三张候选牌念给她，她给解析和分数，选完记进牌组曲线；开局前先看她有没有这个职业的赢法。

**她不动手。** 不模拟点击、不操作游戏。给的是判断和建议，鼠标在你手上——不听也是你的牌。

**第一次启动会替你把 Power 日志的上限打开**（改的是炉石自己 client.config 里的 FileSizeLimit.Int），否则日志写到 10MB 就停笔，后面全是残影。如果哪天日志又断了，多半是游戏更新把配置覆盖回去了，她会明说数据停在几点。

**已知限制**：看不到对手手牌，也就猜不准对面手里有没有解；卡牌效果只认卡表摘要，遇到生僻牌她会说「这张具体效果我得看牌面」。

---

桌面宠在旁边时，她说话走气泡，还会跟着局面的松紧换表情；打牌时她走路会从你的手牌上跳过去，不挡牌。

en.description:
Hearthstone Companion (needs Coopani 0.2.17+): reads your match from the Power log — heroes, board, hand, mana. Speaks up when it matters: clear or push, afford that card, lethal. Read-only; sets up the log. Reviews the game and remembers your last few dozen results. She also keeps her own play-style file in her own words — what she believes in, what she cannot stand, written as she plays. A lethal she sees is still a lethal she calls.

**Whose read you get is your call.** One button on the panel: her own stance by default, or yours — and yours is not guessed, it is counted from your own match archive: how often you follow the advice, which stretch of the game you stop following it, what you played first when you did not. Recounted after every match. Switching to yours does not turn her into a yes-man: a lethal she sees is still called, and so are the risks the advice names — the stance changes the wording and which line comes first, never the numbers. Arena too; she hops over your hand instead of blocking it.

zh.description:
让桌宠开口前先「想一想」，说话更像个人，少一点 AI 腔。单独装就能用，搭配「活人感 provider」更快。

**它做什么**

- 你对桌宠说话时，先读一下情境、你的心情和桌宠自己的记忆，递给它一句「此刻心里的想法」，再让它开口。
- 桌宠要是用了「不是……而是……」、先复述你的话这类 AI 固定句式，下次就提醒它换个说法。口癖、语气、长短都不碰。

**两个扩展怎么配合**

- **活人感**（就是本扩展，必装）：负责想心事、查句式。单独装就能用。
- **活人感 provider**（可选）：一种新的模型端点「活人感」，把心事直接放进发给模型的请求里。不用它的话，桌宠每次要先调一次工具读心事再开口，多跑一轮，稍慢一点。
- 只装 provider、不装本扩展，没有任何作用。

**怎么用**

1. 在扩展页装上本扩展，重启 Coopanion。
2. 到 World 页打开「活人感」。

主模型用的是 DeepSeek 的话，什么都不用填。用别家的话，在活人感的「配置 → 副 API」里填地址、模型和 Key。

**想更快（用 provider）**

1. 再装上「活人感 provider」，重启。
2. 活人感「配置 → 基本设置」里勾「切换到活人感端点」：照着你现在的端点复制一个「活人感」端点（地址、模型、Key 都一样）并切过去。只支持 Coo 连接的端点。
3. 再重启一次，按提示把活人感关掉再打开一次。

「provider」徽章显示「已生效」就是在用；「provider 注入」是心事塞进请求的次数。没生效时，配置页顶部会写明原因和该怎么做。想停用：关掉「用「活人感 provider」」，或者勾「切回原来的端点」。**卸载 provider 之前一定先勾「切回原来的端点」并重启**，不然桌宠会说不了话。

**要知道的**

- 你每说一句话，会多调用一次副 API（默认 DeepSeek，约 1–2 秒，花费很少）。
- 默认读桌宠、控制台、QQ 私聊和 @桌宠的消息。QQ 群里别人的话会经过副 API 影响心事，介意的话可以在配置里关掉。
- 只支持中文，目前只在 Windows + DeepSeek 上测过。
- 不想用了：World 页关掉即可。卸载：扩展页卸掉，重启。

en.description:
Lets the pet think for a moment before it speaks, so it sounds more like a person and less like an AI. Works on its own; faster with the Humanize provider.

**What it does**

- When you talk to the pet, it reads the situation, your mood and the pet's own memory, and hands the pet a short inner thought before it answers.
- When the pet slips into stock AI sentence patterns ("not X but Y", parroting your words back), it is reminded to say it another way next time. Catchphrases, tone and length are left alone.

**How the two extensions fit together**

- **Humanize** (this one, required): writes the inner thought and checks sentence patterns. Works on its own.
- **Humanize provider** (optional): a new model endpoint type, "Humanize", that puts the thought straight into the request sent to the model. Without it, the pet first calls a tool to read the thought, which costs one extra round.
- The provider alone does nothing.

**Getting started**

1. Install this extension on the Extensions page and restart Coopanion.
2. Turn on Humanize on the World page.

If your main model is DeepSeek, there is nothing to fill in. Otherwise enter the address, model and key under Config → Side API.

**Faster, with the provider**: install the Humanize provider and restart, tick "Switch to the Humanize endpoint" under Config → Basic (it copies your current Coo endpoint and switches to the copy), restart again, then turn Humanize off and on once. Before uninstalling the provider, tick "Switch back" and restart.

**Good to know**

- Each message you send adds one side-API call (DeepSeek by default, about 1–2 seconds, very cheap).
- Prompts, presets and pattern checks are Chinese only. Tested on Windows with DeepSeek only.
- To stop: turn it off on the World page. To uninstall: remove it on the Extensions page and restart.

en.description:
Coo joins Overcooked! 2 as the second local player and cooks next to you with its own chef. You handle level select and menus; Coo splits the chopping, cooking, washing and serving with you.

**Features**
- Coo queues a chain of actions (take, put, chop, wash, serve, throw, extinguish) that the chef carries out in the background, and hears when it finishes or gets stuck
- Coo can watch pots, orders and other conditions and have actions queued the moment they hold
- The kitchen state (orders, both chefs, every station) rides along with each wake-up, with a full map at intervals
- Fire, pots about to burn, expiring orders and round start and end wake Coo; a campaign level's opening chalkboard comes with a screenshot
- Coo joins as player 2 automatically on the main menu

**Needed after install**
1. Install the game on Steam
2. Install the x86 build of BepInEx 5 in the game directory
3. Build the plugin in the repo's `plugin/` with the .NET SDK and put it in `BepInEx/plugins/`
4. Full steps in the [README](https://github.com/Phantivia/cortico-world-overcooked2#before-you-install)

en.description:
Lets Coo play the original PopCap Plants vs. Zombies. An implant reads semantic state from the game memory, and Coo picks seeds, plants, shovels and works the menus on its own.

**Features**
- Reads the current screen, the plants and zombies in every cell, card cooldowns, sun and level progress
- Queues a series of actions, with a receipt when the task ends
- Arms triggers that act when zombies approach, a card becomes ready or a cell frees up
- Collects sun automatically; plays Adventure and most minigames
- Draws its cursor inside the game window and leaves the system mouse alone

**After installing you also need**
1. Your own copy of the GOTY 1.2.0.1073 APAC Japanese branch with Chinese resources, whose PlantsVsZombies.exe and main.pak hashes must match
2. Visual Studio Build Tools 2022 with the x86 C++ toolchain
3. Choose PlantsVsZombies.exe on the configuration page; the World compiles the implant from src/native/ the first time you press Start game

zh.description:
通过 QQ 官方机器人接口，让 Cortico / Coopanion 收取消息并发送回复。

- 手机 QQ 扫码绑定，自动保存凭证并展示连接状态；也可手动配置。
- 接收单聊、群聊与频道事件，支持被动回复、主动消息和宿主定时通知。
- 发送图片、语音、视频与文件，支持引用附件读取和 C2C 流式回复。
- 8 个工具、6 类事件；支持 WebSocket 网关和签名 Webhook。

需要 QQ 机器人账号与相应权限；音频转码需要 FFmpeg。媒体使用宿主管理的附件或公开 URL；不读取模型指定的本地路径。界面截图使用示例数据。

作者：[leafliber](https://github.com/leafliber)。本项目是独立的社区扩展；名称中的“官方”指 QQ 官方接口，不表示腾讯或 Cortico 官方出品。

en.description:
Connect Cortico / Coopanion to the QQ Official Bot API.

- Bind a bot by scanning with QQ; credentials are saved automatically, with connection status shown in the panel. Manual configuration is also available.
- Receive direct, group and channel events; send replies, proactive messages and host-scheduled notifications.
- Send images, voice, video and files; read quoted attachments and stream C2C replies.
- 8 tools and 6 event types, with WebSocket gateway and signed Webhook transports.

Requires a QQ bot account and platform permissions. Audio conversion requires FFmpeg. Media is sent from host-managed attachments or public URLs; model-supplied local paths are not read. Screenshots use sample data.

By [leafliber](https://github.com/leafliber). This is an independent community extension; “Official” refers to QQ’s official API, not endorsement by Tencent or Cortico.

en.description:
Connects Coo to a QQ bot entry for QQ direct and group messages.

- Create and bind a bot by scanning with mobile QQ; credentials are saved and the connection starts on its own.
- Each message becomes one line: sender, faces, quotes and attachments; images go to models that take images.
- QQ's reply counts, reply windows, proactive and wakeup quotas are in the prompt, and every send receipt says what is left.
- Sends text, stickers, images, video and files, with word-by-word replies in direct chats; voice with FFmpeg installed.

The scanned bot is a personal bot: by default only you can message it, and it can join only groups you own or manage. Maintained by Pal AI Lab, originally written by [leafliber](https://github.com/leafliber).

cortico-world-sisterdrive.description: Cortico World for Teach my little sister how to drive: the bot instructs the sister by voice, through a BepInEx plugin that feeds synthesized speech to the game and turns game calls into events.

zh.description:
让 Coo 坐副驾驶，用语音教《Teach my little sister how to drive》里的妹妹开车，妹妹由游戏自己的模型扮演。

**功能**
- Coo 对妹妹说的话用本机语音合成服务合成，当作麦克风输入送进游戏
- 妹妹的回话、她听懂的驾驶动作和计划进度推回给 Coo
- 任务、提示、情境区、罚款、碰撞、地雷、情绪变化、关卡结束等事件实时推给 Coo,部分附截图
- 关卡中定时附最新画面与车顶俯视图,Coo 太久没开口时用画面唤醒一次
- Coo 可截图看路况，重开、进下一关、回主菜单或继续存档
- World 页「游戏」面板启动游戏，显示游戏与插件连接状态

**安装后还需要**
1. 在 Steam 安装游戏，建议复制一份到 Steam 库外
2. 在游戏目录装 BepInEx 5,用 .NET 8 SDK 编译仓里 `plugin/` 的插件，放进 `BepInEx/plugins/`
3. 本机运行兼容 OpenAI `/v1/audio/speech` 的 VoxCPM2 语音合成服务
4. 详细步骤见 [README](https://github.com/Phantivia/cortico-world-sisterdrive#安装前准备)

仅 Windows。CortiV 直播验证过的参考实现，别的 Persona 与非直播场景的兼容性没有测试过。

en.displayName: Teach My Little Sister How to Drive
en.description:
Coo rides in the passenger seat of Teach my little sister how to drive and teaches the sister to drive by voice. The game's own model plays the sister and does the driving.

**Features**
- What Coo says to the sister is synthesized by a local speech service and fed to the game as microphone input
- Her reply, the driving actions she understood and her plan progress come back to Coo
- Missions, hints, situation zones, fines, collisions, mines, mood changes and stage results reach Coo as they happen, some with a screenshot
- A fresh view with a top-down view of the car rides along during a stage, and wakes Coo when Coo has been silent too long
- Coo can look at the road, restart, load the next stage, return to the menu or continue the save
- The 游戏 (Game) panel on the World page starts the game and shows whether the game and plugin are connected

**Needed after install**
1. Install the game on Steam, preferably copied outside the Steam library
2. Install BepInEx 5 in the game directory, build the plugin in the repo's `plugin/` with the .NET 8 SDK, and put it in `BepInEx/plugins/`
3. Run a VoxCPM2 speech service with the OpenAI `/v1/audio/speech` API on this machine
4. Full steps in the [README](https://github.com/Phantivia/cortico-world-sisterdrive#before-you-install)

Windows only. A reference implementation verified on CortiV live streams; compatibility with other Personas and non-streaming setups has not been tested.

zh.description:
看她自己的账本，把花费拆开看：钱花在哪一项、缓存省了多少、上下文里到底装的什么、哪个扩展在烧 token。

**它只读**：翻三个文件——`data/usage.jsonl`（每次请求的 token 与官方金额）、`runs/*/transcript.jsonl`（上下文里实际装的内容）、`runs/*/toolcalls.jsonl`（哪次调用属于哪个世界）。只以只读方式打开，不改任何东西。

**它不费钱**：全部在这台机器上算，不调用模型，不给桌宠任何工具，也不往她的上下文里加一个字。所以它观察账单这件事本身是零成本的——这正是做它的理由，先看清楚钱去哪了，再决定改什么。

**今天花了多少**：最上面一张卡。从本地时间 0 点起算到此刻，跨过 0 点自动归零，相当于「今天到目前为止花了多少钱」。同时给出按当前速度估算的全天、昨天的全天数字，以及今天每个小时的分布。顶栏徽标也常显示今天的金额（没点开面板也算，走一条只解析今天几十行的快路，20 秒缓存）。

**四张表**：

- **钱**：按每次请求当时的价格快照累加的官方金额，以人民币为主（美元附在旁边，汇率可配）；再拆成命中缓存的输入、未命中缓存的输入、输出三项。表下会注明两件事：有几次请求账本里没带金额（价目表里没有那个模型），按牌价折算是多少钱；以及账本写到几点为止。
- **缓存**：命中率，以及「单次未命中超过 2 万 token」的事件列表。这类事件几乎都发生在前缀第一次出现时——那不是浪费，是换一套前缀必须付的一次钱。
- **成分**：上下文里工具回执、工具参数、她的思考、你说的话各占多少。同一个内容重复出现只算一次，不重复计。
- **按世界**：哪个扩展在烧 token。

**要说清的一件事**：「按世界」是估算。账本按请求记账、不按工具记账，所以这一栏是按每条工具回执的字数折算后归到它所属的世界。看排行和量级可以，别当账单。

面板打开时算一次（本机约 0.3 秒），之后账本没变就用缓存；想看最新的点「重新算一遍」。

en.description:
Reads her own ledger and splits the bill: which meter the money went to, how much caching saved, what actually sits in the context, and which extension burns tokens.

**Read-only**: it opens three files — `data/usage.jsonl` (tokens and official charges per request), `runs/*/transcript.jsonl` (what really sits in the context) and `runs/*/toolcalls.jsonl` (which world each call belonged to). Opened read-only; nothing is modified.

**It costs nothing**: everything is computed locally. No model calls, no tools for the pet, not a single character added to her context. Watching the bill is free — which is the point: see where the money goes before changing anything.

**Spent today**: the top card. Counted from local midnight to now and reset automatically when the day turns — in effect, what today has cost so far. It also shows a pace-based forecast for the full day, yesterday's whole-day figure, and the hourly split for today. The module badge shows today's amount too, even before the panel is opened, via a fast path that parses only today's few dozen lines (20 s cache).

**Four tables**:

- **Money**: official charges accumulated from the price snapshot of each request, shown in CNY first with USD alongside (rate configurable); split into cached input, uncached input and output. Under the table it also states how many requests carried no amount (the model was missing from the price table) and what they would cost at listed prices, plus the moment the ledger currently runs through.
- **Cache**: hit rate, plus every event where a single miss exceeded 20k tokens. Those nearly always happen on the first appearance of a prefix — not waste, but the one-time cost of switching prefixes.
- **Composition**: how much of the context is tool receipts, tool arguments, her reasoning, your messages. Repeated content is counted once.
- **By world**: which extension burns tokens.

**One caveat**: the per-world split is an estimate. The ledger bills per request, not per tool, so that column attributes each receipt by character count to its owning world. Good for ranking, not for accounting.

The panel computes once when opened (about 0.3 s locally) and serves cache until the ledger changes; press Recompute for the latest.

zh.description:
让桌宠真的坐到游戏里去玩一部 Ren'Py 视觉小说，而不是读剧本演给你看。

**她怎么玩的**：她说「开吧」，桌宠就自己启动游戏、点「开始游戏」、一页页往下读，遇到选项时停下来问你、或者自己挑一个。你该干嘛干嘛，看完一段她会挑一句说说感想。

**为什么不用截图认字**：启动游戏时，插件让 Ren'Py 把它自己的台词文本交出来（`renpy.exports.say`、`renpy.exports.menu`），所以台词是**精确原文**，一个字都不会认错，也不花视觉 token。

**她不会做的事**：不读剧本文件、不解包 `.rpa`、不截图认字、不模拟鼠标乱点；不改游戏文件（桥接靠 `RENPY_SEARCHPATH` 注入）；不动你原来的存档（启动时 `--savedir` 指到插件自己的目录 `<数据目录>/vn/saves/`）；关掉 Coopanion 也不会顺手关掉游戏窗口。

**她要用的动作**：`vn_start` 开局、`vn_lines` 看演到哪、`vn_state` 看当前状态、`vn_advance` 手动推一句、`vn_choose` 在选项里挑、`vn_click` 点界面按钮、`vn_stop` 收摊。

**装它还需要什么**：一个 Ren'Py 8.x 游戏本体（自带 `renpy/` 与 `game/` 目录），然后在 World 设置里填「游戏目录」。任何 Ren'Py 游戏都能用，换游戏只改这一个路径。

**已知限制**：仅 Windows；只支持 Ren'Py 引擎；个别自定义界面可能采不到按钮（标记为实验性）。

en.description:
Lets the desktop pet actually sit down and play a Ren'Py visual novel, instead of reading a script out loud.

**How she plays**: she starts the game, clicks Start, reads page after page, and stops only when a choice appears — then she picks one or asks you. Dialogue text is read by nobody but her; the game advances on its own.

**Why no OCR**: at launch the plugin asks Ren'Py for its own dialogue text (`renpy.exports.say`, `renpy.exports.menu`), so lines are exact and cost no vision tokens.

**What it will not do**: no script parsing, no `.rpa` unpacking, no screenshots, no blind mouse clicking; the game files stay untouched (the bridge is injected via `RENPY_SEARCHPATH`); your existing saves are never touched (a private `--savedir` under `<data>/vn/saves/`); closing Coopanion does not close the game window.

**Tools**: `vn_start`, `vn_lines`, `vn_state`, `vn_advance`, `vn_choose`, `vn_click`, `vn_stop`.

**What you need**: a Ren'Py 8.x game that ships its own `renpy/` and `game/` folders, and its path in the World settings. Works for any Ren'Py game; switching games means changing that one path.

**Limits**: Windows only; Ren'Py only; a few custom UIs may not expose their buttons (marked experimental).

**功能**
- World 页签里点选要盯的窗口,或 3 秒后盯住前台窗口
- Coo 也能自己列出窗口、按编号或标题选一个、换窗口或停下

**平台与权限**
- Windows:装好就能用
- macOS:要在「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 录屏与系统录音」里允许运行 Cortico 的应用,再重启它
- Linux:只支持 X11(Xorg)会话,Wayland 下看不到别的程序的窗口

主模型要能看图。每张观察帧都让 Coo 跑一轮,窗口画面会发给你配置的模型服务。详见 [README](https://github.com/Phantivia/cortico-world-watch-window#中文)。

en.description:
Lets Coo watch one desktop window as a video stream: its frames are laid out as a timed grid and sent to the main conversation at intervals, and Coo decides whether to say anything.

**Features**
- Pick the window in the World tab, or watch the front window after 3 seconds
- Coo can list windows itself, pick one by number or title, switch or stop
- A grid of 1 to 9 frames at intervals with cuts noted; nothing is sent while the picture is still
- A large image of the window, or a zoomed region, when Coo needs a closer look
- The window's edge flashes white when picked; the glow stays out of the observations

**Platforms and permissions**
- Windows: works right after install
- macOS: allow the app that runs Cortico under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen & System Audio Recording, then restart it
- Linux: X11 (Xorg) sessions only; a Wayland session cannot see other applications' windows

The main model must accept images. Every observation runs a model round and sends the window's picture to your configured model endpoint. See the [README](https://github.com/Phantivia/cortico-world-watch-window#english).
